3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: The state in which both sides give and both receive, checked by asking each side what the other gives.
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: The state in which both sides give and both receive, checked by asking each side what the other gives.

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: 互いに与え合い、互いに受け取る関係である。お互いが実際に何を与えているかを確かめることで、組織的な一方通行や不均衡がなくなる。
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: 双方が与え、双方が受け取る関係。

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: 양쪽 모두 상대에게 무언가를 주고받으며, 상대가 무엇을 주고받는지 서로에게 확인할 수 있는 관계를 말한다. 한쪽만 계속 희생하거나 변화를 시도하는 관계는 상호성이 부족하다.
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: 양쪽이 서로에게 주고주고 받으며 그 관계가 상호적인 상태.

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: Relação em que as duas partes contribuem e se beneficiam. Para conferir, pergunta-se a cada lado o que recebe do outro: se só um lado dá, não há mutualidade.
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: O estado em que os dois lados dão e os dois lados recebem, verificado perguntando a cada um o que o outro lhe dá.

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: Kesalingan adalah keadaan ketika kedua pihak memberi dan menerima secara berbalik. Hal ini dapat diperiksa dengan menanyakan kepada masing-masing pihak tentang apa yang diterimanya dari pihak lain.
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: Keadaan kedua pihak sama-sama memberi dan sama-sama menerima.

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: ภาวะที่การให้และการได้รับเกิดขึ้นทั้งสองฝ่าย อาจตรวจสอบได้โดยการถามแต่ละฝ่ายว่าอีกฝ่ายให้อะไรบ้าง
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: ภาวะที่ทั้งสองฝ่ายให้และทั้งสองฝ่ายได้รับ

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.definition: İki tarafın da birbirine bir şey verdiği ve birbirinden bir şey aldığı durum. Her iki tarafın da diğerinin ne verdiğini sorarak karşılıklılığın gerçek olup olmadığı anlaşılabilir.
3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.gloss: Her iki tarafın da verdiği ve karşılığında bir şey aldığı karşılıklılık.

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.translation: Burada karşılıklılık yoktu; biri bütün ikramı yapıyordu.
ที่นี่ไม่มีภาวะต่างตอนแทนกัน เพราะฝ่ายหนึ่งเป็นผู้ให้ทั้งหมด
Tidak ada kesalingan di sini: satu pihak melakukan semua pemberian, sedangkan pihak lain hanya menerima.
Aqui não há mutualidade: um dos dois faz todo o trabalho de dar.
이 관계에는 상호성이 없다. 한쪽이 모든 것을 주고 다른 쪽은 받기만 한다.
ここに相互性はない。一方の人が与えているだけだ。

3a22f7c97b5e821d310b9be128a6e3b78579d208.text: There is no mutuality here: one of them does all the giving.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: The age or stage at which a milestone is expected in a given community.
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: The age or stage at which a milestone is expected in a given community.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: 特定の社会や共同体で、節目，比如生日や入学、成人式などがResolve Naturallyな年齢や段階を指す。
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: ある社会で節目が期待される年齢や段階。

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: 어떤 공동체에서 특정 발달 단계가 이루어질 것으로 통상적으로 예상되는 나이 또는 시기를 이르는 말이다. 실제 시기가 아니라 사회적으로 기대되는 기준을 가리킨다.
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: 어떤 공동체에서 어떤 발달 단계가 이루어질 것으로 예상되는 나이 또는 시기.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: O momento em que se espera que um acontecimento da vida ocorra segundo os costumes de um grupo. É uma expectativa social, não uma medida do que de fato aconteceu com alguém.
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: A idade ou a etapa em que um marco é esperado em determinada comunidade.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: Usia atau tahap perkembangan ketika suatu peristiwa diharapkan terjadi dalam kelompok masyarakat tertentu. Ini merupakan Expectations umum, bukan ukuran tentang perkembangan nyata seseorang.
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: Waktu yang dianggap wajar bagi suatu peristiwa dalam masyarakat.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: อายุหรือช่วงชีวิตที่ชุมชนหนึ่งคาดหวังให้เหตุการณ์สำคัญ เช่น การแต่งงานหรือการมีบุตร เกิดขึ้น เป็นเกณฑ์ทางสังคม ไม่ใช่ข้อบังคับจริง
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: กรอบเวลาที่สังคมคาดหวังให้เหตุการณ์สำคัญเกิดขึ้น

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.definition: Evlilik, çocuk sahibi olma ya da işe başlama gibi bir olayın belirli bir toplulukta hangi yaşta veya hangi aşamada beklenildiğini anlatır. Gerçek kişilerin davranışını değil, o topluluğun varsayılan beklentisini gösterir.
3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.gloss: Verilen bir toplulukta bir kilometre taşının hangi yaşta ya da hangi evrede beklendiği.

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.translation: Normatif zamanlama, insanların sormadığında varsaydığı şeydir: otuz yaşında evlenmek beklentisi gibi.
กรอบเวลาที่สังคมคาดหวังคือสิ่งที่ผู้คนมักถือเป็นมาตรฐานเมื่อไม่ได้ถาม
Dalam kelompok itu, waktu normatif bagi perkawinan adalah usia dua puluh lima tahun.
O tempo normativo é aquilo que as pessoas presumem quando não perguntam.
사람들이developmental milestones를 물어보지 않을 때 가정하는 것은 규범적 시기이다.
特別な Indicationsがない場合、人々は社会的な規範的な時期を前提とする。

3a2cdb8f0389ac47cd523e6c784ba0f3b51271b5.text: The normative timing is what people assume when they do not ask.

Information collected as figures or records.
